reason: A DSH web interface enhancement plugin focused on themes, layout improvements, collapsible message elements, usage visualization, and an accompanying Electron desktop shell.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供主题与布局优化、可折叠消息元素、账户用量可视化，并附带 Electron 桌面壳。
summaries.en: Enhances the DSH web interface with theme and layout improvements, collapsible message elements, usage visualization, and an accompanying Electron desktop shell.

capabilities: Modifies the DSH web interface theme and layout
Aggregates thinking blocks and tool-call chains into collapsible UI elements
Displays DeepSeek account balance, token cost, and usage charts when an API key is configured
Provides an Electron desktop shell for launching the DSH web interface
